items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Old Man Valto, he played violin there for a long time.

ctx.x: Pete Lala's that band, you say it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto?

Yeah, it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto. Who else was there? Old Man Valto was there for a while, and then, let me see, there was, Jimmy Pallow was there for a while. You heard talking about Jimmy Pallow? Did you hear Jimmy Pallow? He was a violinist, Jimmy Pallow was, you know. He was there for a while. Old Man Valto, he played violin there for a long time. Will Elfrey, tell him Will Elfrey. I know him. Do you know Will Elfrey? I don't mean the son.
